title: Editor Paint Isolation and Retained Terrain Activation
changes: Restricted machine-local World Paint render bindings to developer mode instead of normal gameplay.
Stopped persisted paint caches from disabling the retained direct-LPC terrain surface.
Prevented stale grass, sand, shallow-water, and ocean paint cells from overlaying regenerated semantic terrain in the production client.
Added regression tests for editor-only paint activation and retained-surface eligibility.

validation.liveAcceptance: verify FPS, pond contour, ocean shore, and absence of grass-in-water with F3 off
